description: This script manages and synchronizes specific plugin SDK exports in a Node.js project. It reads the package.json, compares current exports with the desired exports generated by a function, and updates the package.json accordingly, with support for a check mode.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: External function imported from 'lib/plugin-sdk-entries.mjs' that generates the desired plugin SDK export entries.
